simple.meaning: רֵאשִׁית (rêʼshîyth) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “the first , in place, time, order or rank (specifically, a firstfruit ).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 51 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 14 more, beginning at Genesis 1:1. Its contexts include birth, offering, firstborn, altar, kingship, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to רֵאשִׁית (H7225).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: רֵאשִׁית (rêʼshîyth) / H7225 is traced through Genesis 1:1, Genesis 10:10, Genesis 49:3, Exodus 23:19 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H7225. reshith [ רֵאשִׁית ] noun feminine beginning, chief (for * רְאֵשִׁית Nö GGA 1884, 1019 , compare Holz Hexateuch 465 ; Syriac ); — absolute ׳ר Deut 33:21 +, construct ׳ר Gen 10:10 +, רֵשִׁית Deut 11:12 ; suffix רֵאשִׁיתוֺ Eccl 7:8 , רֵאשִׁתוֺ Job 42:12 , etc.; — 1.a beginning of kingdom Gen 10:10 (J), year Deut 11:12 , reign Jer 26:1 ; 27:1 ; 28:1 ; 49:34 ;= first phase, step, or element in course of events Isa 46:10 (opposed to אַחֲרִית ); of a thing ( דָּבָר ) Eccl 7:8 (opposed to id.); of sin Micah 1:13 , strife Prov 17:14 , wisdom Psa 111:10 , knowledge Prov 1:7 thy beginning Job 8:7 +? his beginning 42:12 (both opposed to אַחֲרִית ), ׳ר before clause, ׳בְּר א ׳בָּרָא Gen 1:1 in the beginning when god created (> absolute in the beginning God created ); ׳ר אֹנִי 49:3 (poem) beginning (first product) of my manly vigour (|| כֹּחִי בְּכֹרִי so Deut 21:17 ; Psa 78:51 (both || בְּכוֺת 105:36 ; compare ׳ר אֵל דֵּרְכֵי Job 40:19 (of hippopotamus), ׳ר דַּרְכּוֺ Prov 8:22 (of wisdom);=first season (of a tree) Hosea 9:10 ; גּוֺיִם׳ר Num 24:20 (JE), first, earliest, of nations . b. first of fruits Exod 23:19 (E), 34:26 (JE), Deut 26:2 , 10 ; Ezek 44:30 .a, of harvest Lev 23:10 (H), grain Deut 18:4 ; 2Chr 31:5 dough Num 15:20-21 , (P), Ezek 44:30 b Neh 10:38 , wool Deut 18:4 ; of כָּלתְּֿבוּאָתֶ֑ךָ Prov 3:9 ; Israel is ׳ר תְּבוּאָתֹה Jer 2:3 (i.e. of ׳י s increase); ׳ר = first-fruits Lev 2:12 (P), Num 18:12 (P), Neh 12:44 ; ׳ר הָאָרֶץ Ezek 48:14 2 first chief , Amos 6:1 ; ׳ר גְּבוּרָתָם Jer 49:35 (of bows); so apparently ׳ר עַמּוֺן בְּנֵי Dan 11:41 , i.e. the principal part of them (Buhl Marti conjecture שְׁאֵרִית after ᵑ6 ); ׳ר מַשְׁאוֺתֵיכֶם Ezek 20:40 , i.e. your chief oblations; ׳ר שְׁמָנִים Amos 6:6 , i.e. choice oils; = choice part, of land Deut 33:21 , offering 1Sam 2:29 , הַחֵרֶם 15:21 ; absolute chief thing Prov 4:7 (of wisdom).
